copy_policy: Retained generated programs, datasets and per-case statistics preserve their original bytes. Historical aggregate grading logs are excluded; functional grading is computed separately.

selection.python: Preserved Python results; datasets and generated programs are unchanged.
selection.table1: Full vanilla results plus the recorded failure-subset GenCor/baseline runs. ReSample output directories are preserved in full.
selection.table2: All 72 ChopChop tasks for each model and seed, both methods.

verification: checksums.sha256 covers all 81,055 submitted data files at their current paths, relative to this directory.
